T: Marry the girl. Marry the family.
D: An English auctioneer discovers his fiancée's family runs with the mob.
P: Serve the mains when Michael tries to do the Kansas City accent.
S: Cured meats fanned out, bocconcini dressed with basil and oil, marinated artichokes, and button mushrooms roasted with garlic and thyme at 200C for 15 minutes.
Crustless white bread with cucumber and butter, egg and cress, smoked salmon and cream cheese, cut in fingers.
Michael's cover story, Mickey Blue Eyes from Kansas City

Ricotta ravioli dipped in egg and Italian breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, parmesan and warm marinara to dip. Dip 400g fresh ricotta ravioli in 2 beaten eggs, then in 120g breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then drain. Shower with 30g grated parmesan and serve with 300ml warm passata seasoned with salt and oregano for dipping.
M: Gina's dad's restaurant, where the family drops in

Purge clams, steam open with garlic, chilli and white wine, tossed through linguine and brought to the table in the pan. Soak 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge. Gently fry 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli in 60ml olive oil, add the clams and 150ml white wine, cover and steam 4 minutes until open. Cook 400g linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with chopped parsley and more olive oil.
the mob dinner Michael can't get out of
Chicken breast pounded thin, floured, egged and crumbed, fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan and grilled until bubbling.
W: Michael's accent lesson, say it slower

Whisk 4 yolks with 100g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone then 4 whites whipped stiff. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g caster sugar until pale, then fold in 500g mascarpone and 4 egg whites whipped stiff. Mix 300ml strong espresso with 3 tbsp marsala. Dip 24 savoiardi biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish. Dust with 2 tbsp cocoa and chill overnight.
K: Auction house gin and elderflower collins
for Michael, a very nervous English auctioneer

Gin shaken with elderflower cordial and lemon, topped with soda over ice with ribbons of cucumber and fresh mint. Peel 8 long ribbons from 1 Lebanese cucumber and curl two into each of 4 tall glasses, then fill with ice. Shake 160ml gin, 60ml elderflower cordial and 60ml lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain over the glasses and top each with 100ml soda water. Add a sprig of mint and serve.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, then mash with mayonnaise and cress.
Butter the bread. Make 2 sandwiches with cucumber, 2 with the egg and 2 with smoked salmon on cream cheese.
Cut off the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dip the ravioli in egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then drain.
Warm the passata with salt and oregano for dipping.
Shower the ravioli with parmesan and serve.
Soak the clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge, then rinse.
Gently fry the garlic and chilli in some of the olive oil, add the clams and wine, cover and steam for 4 minutes until open.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with parsley and more olive oil.

dishes.make_ahead: Make 1 day ahead, keep chilled; best overnight

steps.text: Whisk the yolks and sugar until pale, then fold in the mascarpone.
Whip the egg whites stiff and fold into the cream.
Mix the espresso with the marsala, dip the biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish.
Dust with cocoa and chill overnight.

dishes.n: Auction house gin and elderflower collins

steps.text: Peel 8 long ribbons from the cucumber and curl two into each of four tall glasses, then fill with ice.
Shake the gin, cordial and lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds.

dishes.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead; fill shells just before serving

ingredients.item: icing sugar, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Drain the ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours.
Beat with icing sugar and orange zest, then fold in the chocolate.
Pipe into the shells just before serving and dust with icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak up to 2 hours ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the squid into rings and soak in the buttermilk for 30 minutes.
Mix the semolina, flour and plenty of salt.
Drain the squid and toss through the flour mix.
Fry at 190C in batches for 90 seconds each.
Salt and serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the pork in olive oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, stir in the tomato paste, then add the tomatoes and basil.
Return the pork and simmer gently until the meat is falling apart.
Boil the rigatoni, toss with the sauce and serve with pecorino.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dust the veal in flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry 2 minutes a side until golden.
Top each cutlet with warm passata, mozzarella and parmesan and grill until bubbling.
Serve with the rest of the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the chicken and sausage in olive oil, then set aside.
Soften the garlic with the peppers and rosemary, add the vinegar and stock and scrape up the pan.
Return the meat, cover and cook gently until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy.
Open the bottle and pour a glass per guest.
Brew four short, strong espressos.
Serve in small cups.
